checks.title: the steps are an ordered list with their states and times; the running one is aria-current; the run is running, its region named by label
checks.covers: settings.steps, settings.label, settings.run-state auto, host-states data-state, accessibility.role region

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); const root = el.querySelector('section.sf-progress-run'); const steps = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-step')]; return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'running' && document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent === 'Создание сайта demo.test' && steps.map((s) => s.dataset.state).join(',') === 'done,done,running,waiting' && steps[2].getAttribute('aria-current') === 'step' && steps[0].querySelector('.sf-progress-run-time').textContent === '0:01' && steps[1].querySelector('.sf-progress-run-time').textContent === '0:05' && steps[0].querySelector('.sr-only').textContent === ', готово' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-cancel') && !el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-retry') && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result').textContent.trim() === ''; })()

checks.title: Cancel asks sf-progress-run-cancel; the run changes nothing by itself
chunk appends to the output; the pane follows the end while the reader is there, and keeps a reader who scrolled up

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); let lines = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i += 1) lines += `line ${i}\n`; return el.chunk({text: lines}).outcome === 'applied'; })()
steps.check: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('#run .sf-progress-run-output'); return pane.getAttribute('role') === 'log' && pane.querySelector('pre').textContent.includes('line 59') && pane.scrollHeight - pane.scrollTop - pane.clientHeight < 2; })()

steps.script: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('#run .sf-progress-run-output'); pane.scrollTop = 0; document.querySelector('#run').chunk({text: 'more\n'}); return true; })()

checks.title: step changes one step; when the last is done the run is done, the result line says «Готово» in its status region and Hide shows

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); el.step({id: 'db', state: 'done', duration: 2000}); el.step({id: 'ssl', state: 'done', duration: 900}); return el.step({id: 'nope', state: 'done'}).outcome === 'refused'; })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); const result = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'done' && result.getAttribute('role') === 'status' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result-text').textContent === 'Готово' && !el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-cancel') && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-hide'); })()

checks.title: a failed run says the host's reason and offers Retry, which sends sf-progress-run-retry

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#failed'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'failed' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result-text').textContent === 'Файл повреждён' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-icon--failed'); })()

checks.title: the output toggle opens and closes the pane with aria-expanded; download is a cancelable request

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#failed'); const toggle = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-toggle button'); return el.outputOpen === true && toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-output'); })()
